LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Hint: These switches and thresholds apply to every nanny robot immediately. Pause, recall, goto, rename and paint are available on each selected robot.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Sweep.Desc: Clean filth inside the home area.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Scrub.Desc: Clean filth outside the home area, such as after a raid.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Haul.Desc: Carry loose items into vertical warehouses or stockpiles. Corpses are skipped.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Firefight.De: Beat out fires inside the work area.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Butcher.Desc: Use butcher-table bills to process corpses.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Refuel.Desc: Refuel wood-fired and chemfuel generators below the threshold.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.FeedPrisoner: Feed or deliver meals to hungry colony prisoners.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Hygiene.Desc: Empty septic tanks and unblock fixtures. Bathroom floor filth is still handled even when sweeping is off.
Rope colony animals back to pens or hitching posts, and unrope them when needed.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Storage.Desc: Prefer delivering hauled items directly into vertical warehouses.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Rescue.Desc: Carry downed colony members to a bed first.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.DangerAvoida: Stop chores and return to the station while enemies are near or the map is at high danger.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.StartWithMkV: Spawn one Mk-V on the player's starting map in a new game. Existing saves are not affected.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVCombatEna: Let Mk-V acquire targets, fire and return automatically. When off, Mk-V only performs chores.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVReturnToB: Return to the Mk-V assembly bay when the target leaves engage range. When off, Mk-V resumes chores in place.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVAutoPicku: Mk-V looks for a higher-scoring ranged weapon and swaps to it. When off, it keeps its issued arc emitter.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.MkVBayAutoSt: When materials, power and research are all available, the Mk-V bay starts the next robot automatically. When off, start it manually.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.AreaLabel.De: Name of an area on the map. If it is missing, work is unrestricted.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.DurabilityHi: Durability caps at 1000. It only drops when the robot takes damage (about 250 damage scraps it); daily work does not wear it down. At 0 it scraps into steel and components. Colonists repair it with the Construction work type. Charging is blocked while the robot is being repaired and resumes after repair finishes.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.Sounds.Desc: Occasional beeps while working; one low-battery warning.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Robotics.ChargingGlow: Light the station while a robot is docked and charging.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Inspect.Repairing: Being repaired: charging waits until repair finishes.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.DisabledInSettings: Disabled in the robot settings page.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Scrapped: {0} was scrapped into steel and components.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Pause.Desc: Pause automatic work. Danger avoidance still applies.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Recall.Desc: Return to the nearest station and wait there.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.Goto.Desc: Pick a cell for the robot to walk to.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Command.PrioritizeFilth.Desc: Pick a filth thing for the robot to clean immediately.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.Locate.Desc: Jump the camera to the bound robot's current position.
LanguageData.CK.Robotics.Station.Recall.Desc: Order the bound robot back to this station.
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.Title: Robots
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.Hint: All nanny robots on this map. Select jumps to a robot; Station jumps to its charging station.
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.None: No nanny robots on this map.
LanguageData.CK.RobotManagement.WorkHint: Priorities 1–8 (1 is highest): left-click lowers, right-click raises; 0 disables the chore. The settings tab master switch still has to be on.
